/* Slide-out Menu */
.slide-menu-overlay {

    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    z-index: 9995;
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease, visibility 0.3s ease;
}
.slide-menu-overlay.active {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
}
.slide-menu {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 280px;
    max-width: 85vw;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0a0f19 0%, #111827 100%);
    border-left: 1px solid var(--panel-border-hover);
    z-index: 9996;
    transform: translateX(100%);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease, visibility 0.3s ease;
    height: 100vh;
    height: 100dvh;
    overflow-y: auto !important;
    overflow-x: clip;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    /* Safari iOS: touch-action on menu AND children must allow vertical pan.
       mobile-polish.css sets touch-action:manipulation on all <a>/<button> which
       can block scroll-through on Safari. Override here. */
    touch-action: pan-y;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    padding: 20px 0 calc(80px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
    scrollbar-width: thin;
    scrollbar-color: rgba(0, 207, 255, 0.2) transparent;
    visibility: hidden;
}

.slide-menu .slide-menu-section-title {
    touch-action: pan-y !important;

        // Check all possible token storage keys (auth.js uses accessToken, others may use auth_token)
        const token = window.getAuthToken();

        // Get username from user object or direct storage
        let displayUsername = localStorage.getItem('username');
        if (!displayUsername) {
            const userJson = localStorage.getItem('user');
            if (userJson) {
                try {
                    const userData = JSON.parse(userJson);
                    displayUsername = userData.username || userData.full_name || userData.email;
                } catch (e) {
                    console.warn('[Header] Failed to parse user data:', e);
                }
            }
        }

        // If we have a session but no username, fetch user data from API.
        // audit #20: gate on the SESSION, not on a readable token — the access
        // token is an httpOnly cookie now, so `token` is legitimately null for a
        // logged-in user and this fetch would never run, leaving the header
        // showing them as signed out.
        var _headerAuthed = (typeof window.hasSession === 'function')
            ? window.hasSession()
            : !!token;
        if (_headerAuthed && !displayUsername && !window._headerFetchingUser) {
            window._headerFetchingUser = true;
            fetch('/auth/me', {
                // Only send the header when a readable token still exists;
                // otherwise the cookie carries the credential.
                headers: token ? { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token } : {}
            })
            .then(function(resp) {
                if (resp.ok) return resp.json();
                throw new Error('Auth failed: ' + resp.status);
            })
            .then(function(userData) {
                // Populate localStorage so future calls don't need to fetch.
                // audit #20: cache the (non-credential) user object only — never
                // back-fill the access token into storage, which would re-create
                // the readable credential this migration removes.
                localStorage.setItem('user', JSON.stringify(userData));
                console.log('[Header] Fetched user data from /auth/me:', userData.username || userData.email);
                window._headerFetchingUser = false;
                updateHeaderAuthState(); // Re-run with populated data
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
                console.warn('[Header] Failed to fetch user data:', err);
                window._headerFetchingUser = false;
            });
            return; // Don't update UI yet, wait for fetch
        }

        // Get the header element for class-based auth state (overrides CSS !important on mobile)
        var headerEl = document.querySelector('.chat-header');

        // audit #20: the RENDER decision must follow the same signal as the fetch
        // gate above. Requiring a readable `token` here meant the header fetched
        // /auth/me successfully, re-ran, and STILL painted "Log In / Sign Up" for
        // a logged-in user — who then clicks it and lands back on the login page,
        // which reads exactly like being booted out.
        if (_headerAuthed && displayUsername) {
            // User is logged in - add class to header so CSS !important rules respect auth state
            if (headerEl) headerEl.classList.add('is-logged-in');

            if (loginBtn) loginBtn.style.display = 'none';
            if (signupBtn) signupBtn.style.display = 'none';
            if (userInfo) userInfo.style.display = 'flex';
            if (usernameEl) usernameEl.textContent = displayUsername;
            if (logoutBtn) logoutBtn.style.display = 'flex';

            // Update hamburger menu
            if (slideMenuBotsTitle) slideMenuBotsTitle.textContent = (window.i18n && window.i18n.t) ? window.i18n.t('menu.my_agents', 'My Agents') : 'My Agents';

            // Fetch and show trading mode indicator
            if (modeIndicator && !window._modeFetching) {
                window._modeFetching = true;
                fetch('/api/v1/account/me', {
                    headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token }
                }).then(function(r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : null; })
                .then(function(data) {
                    window._modeFetching = false;
                    if (!data) return;
                    var isPaper = data.simulation_mode === true;
                    modeIndicator.style.display = 'flex';
                    modeIndicator.className = 'mode-indicator ' + (isPaper ? 'paper' : 'live');
                    modeIndicator.querySelector('.mode-label').textContent = isPaper ? 'PAPER' : 'LIVE';
                    modeIndicator.title = isPaper ? 'Paper Trading Mode — click to switch' : 'Live Trading — click to switch';
                    // EVE-13288: Sync localStorage on initial load (prevents stale banner flash)
                    if (isPaper) {
                        localStorage.setItem('sim_mode', 'true');
                    } else {
                        localStorage.removeItem('sim_mode');
                    }
                    // EVE-13288: Update global banner to match server state
                    var gBanner = document.getElementById('globalSimBanner');
                    if (gBanner) gBanner.style.display = isPaper ? '' : 'none';
                    // Notify components that mode is now known (initial load)
                    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('tradingModeChanged', { detail: { isPaper: isPaper } }));
                }).catch(function() { window._modeFetching = false; });
            }

            console.log('[Header] Auth state updated: logged in as', displayUsername);
        } else {
            // User is not logged in - remove class
            if (headerEl) headerEl.classList.remove('is-logged-in');

            if (loginBtn) loginBtn.style.display = 'flex';
            if (signupBtn) signupBtn.style.display = 'flex';
            if (userInfo) userInfo.style.display = 'none';
            if (logoutBtn) logoutBtn.style.display = 'none';
            if (modeIndicator) modeIndicator.style.display = 'none';

            // Update hamburger menu
            if (slideMenuBotsTitle) slideMenuBotsTitle.textContent = 'Agents';
        }
